description: Return RobotsGate's AI crawler registry: each crawler's robots.txt token, operator, category (training, dataset, search, user_fetch or other), whether the operator says it respects robots.txt, and a link to the operator's documentation, plus unverified entries and notes. Read-only, no network access. Same data as GET /api/crawlers.

category.description: Optional: only crawlers in this category.

name: list_crawlers
title: List the AI crawler registry
